title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-2026-04-01
content:
Weekly release train prep notes — quick scratchpad for the 2026-04-03 sync
Owner: Noah Kim (notes)
Attendees (planned): Maya, Samir, Priya, Evan, Release PM (R. Ortiz)

Meeting goal: go/no-go check for April feature set (v2.3.0) + confirm rollout plan and gating items.

AGENDA (tentative)
- Quick status round-robin (30m)
  - infra & capacity (Samir)
  - runtime stability and regressions (Maya)
  - API/contract/console (Priya)
  - QA & blocking bugs (Evan)
- Launch checklist review (20m)
- Rollout strategy + canary thresholds (10m)
- Final go/no-go call (5m)
- Action items + owners (5m)

LAUNCH CHECKLIST (scratch, copy to runbook)
1) Infra capacity & autoscale configs verified — owner: Samir Patel — status: in_progress — notes: final GPU pool sizing test tomorrow 04-02, need to confirm burst capacity for EMEA peak window (REL-3490).
2) Canary build created and smoke tests passing — owner: Maya Singh — status: in_progress — notes: two flaky smoke tests that fail ~1/20 runs; flaky test list in linked PR.
3) API contract & backward compatibility validation — owner: Priya Kapoor — status: done — notes: no contract breaking changes; minor docs update planned.
4) Migration/backfill plan for user metadata — owner: Evan Ramirez — status: todo — notes: need exact window and migration script validation on staging.
5) Observability dashboards + alerts validated — owner: Samir Patel — status: in_progress — notes: retention policy for trace samples updated; alert thresholds tuned (see Confluence page).
6) Security review & key rotation completed — owner: Noah Kim / Security — status: done — notes: KMS rotate scheduled, keys patched in staging.
7) Release notes + customer comms drafted — owner: Product (R. Ortiz) — status: in_review — notes: need final linkage to support KB article.
8) Rollback playbook & automatic fallback tested — owner: Release Engineering — status: todo — notes: simulate degraded downstream to validate fallback path.

GO/NO-GO CRITERIA (working list)
- Must have: no P0 regressions on main smoke suite; infra capacity validated for peak TPS; rollback path verified.
- Should have: all high-severity (P1) bugs triaged with mitigation; migrations scheduled with downtime < 30m.

CURRENT RISK SUMMARY
- Flaky smoke tests (Maya) — risk: medium (could mask regressions).
- Migration script untested on full staging snapshot (Evan) — risk: high if not run; need dedicated slot 04-02 morning.
- EMEA burst capacity not fully validated under synthetic traffic (Samir) — risk: medium.

NOTES TO SELF / MEETING PROMPTS
- Ask QA for specific flaky test IDs and recent failure logs (link to GH actions).
- Confirm exact rollback SLA we commit to for customers (30m? 1hr?).
- Push for a hard cutover window for metadata migration; if not possible, consider feature gate.
- Remind product to finalize customer comms by EOD 04-02.

ACTION ITEMS (post-meeting follow-ups)
- Samir: run full EMEA stress test 04-02 09:00 PT — deliver logs and summary by 04-02 15:00 PT.
- Maya: reproduce flaky smoke tests on staging and file stabilizing ticket(s) by 04-02 EOD (link to test failures in PR).
- Evan: validate migration script against latest staging snapshot, measure max downtime — target 04-02 12:00 PT.
- Priya: update API docs and post final compatibility note to release notes — target 04-02 17:00 PT.
- Noah: coordinate rollback playbook rehearsal with SRE — schedule 04-02 16:00 PT.
- Product (R. Ortiz): finalize customer comms + KB link — target 04-02 18:00 PT.

DECISION (placeholder)
- Go/No-Go: TBD in meeting 04-03 — to record final decision and reasons here.

LINKS / QUICK REFERENCES
- Runbook: Confluence: release-runbook-2026-q2
- Infra tickets: JIRA: REL-3490, JIRA: REL-3456
- Release scripts PR: github.com/redwood-inference/release-scripts/pull/212
- Smoke test CI history: github.com/redwood-inference/ci/actions?query=smoke%20v2.3

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Do we have a target SLA for rollback that legal/product are happy with? (ask R. Ortiz)
- If migration hits >30m downtime, do we cancel or apply feature gate? Need product decision matrix.

Rough timeline leading up to launch (high-level)
- 04-02: final infra tests, migration validation, docs finalize
- 04-03: release train sync (go/no-go)
- 04-04: dry-run of rollback playbook + canary deploy in low-traffic window
- 04-06: planned gradual rollout start (canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%)

Quick personal checklist before sync:
- [ ] confirm Samir has EMEA stress test slot
- [ ] add migration artifact to runbook
- [ ] ensure product comms link is in linked_artifacts
- [ ] prepare one-slide status for quick readout (stability, infra, QA)

-- end of notes --

(Informal / scratchpad: leave comments inline during meeting; transfer final decisions to runbook and paste into release ticket REL-3456)
